raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyceres
  version: "2.6"

package:
  name: ${{ name }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/cvg/${{ name }}/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: a5893077a39066c855ae77ca4b09522e5ea11e552f1c39ebd51b9bc68a4a854d
    patches:
      - fix-pybind11-tuple-return-type.patch

build:
  number: 7
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  build:
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cmake
    - if: unix
      then: make
    - if: win
      then: ninja
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - pip
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - pybind11
        - numpy
        - scikit-build
        - scikit-build-core
    - pkgconf
  host:
    - pip
    - python
    - pybind11
    # run_exports `pybind11-abi ==<internals version>` so pyceres is only
    # co-installed with pycolmap/pixsfm builds sharing its pybind11 internals
    - pybind11-abi
    - scikit-build
    - scikit-build-core
    - libboost-headers
    - ceres-solver
    - numpy
    - glog
    - gflags
    - libblas
    - libcblas
    - eigen
    - eigen-abi-devel
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyceres
      pip_check: true

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
  summary: pyceres provides minimal Python bindings for the Ceres Solver and the implementation of factor graphs for bundle adjustment and pose graph optimization.
  homepage: https://github.com/cvg/pyceres

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - Tobias-Fischer
